title: open62541 1.5.0 through 1.5.10 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the lookupRefType() function…
description: open62541 versions 1.5.0 through 1.5.10 contain a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the lookupRefType() function. This flaw occurs when resolving a RelativePath string via UA_RelativePath_parseWithServer(), leading to heap corruption and potential server process crashes.
